modernlife.book.title: Modern Life Guide
modernlife.book.page1:
§1§lMODERN LIFE§r

Hello Player! First of all, thank you for downloading this mod. Here I will give you information about the mod. Turn to the next page to get started!
modernlife.book.page2:
§1§lCrafting Recipes§r

ATM:
Put an Iron Block in the top slot, a Chest in the middle slot, and a Redstone Block in the bottom slot (single column, center of the grid).
modernlife.book.page3:
Cash Register:

Iron Ingots in the top-left and top-right corners, a Chest in the very center, and Redstone directly below the Chest.
modernlife.book.page4:
ID Card:

Blue Dye in the top-middle, Paper in the very center, and an Iron Ingot in the bottom-middle.
modernlife.book.page5:
Driver License:

Paper and White Dye, any slots.
modernlife.book.page6:
Mount License:

Paper, Leather and Yellow Dye, any slots.
modernlife.book.page7:
Phone 1:

Iron Ingot, Glass Pane, Redstone and Orange Dye, any slots.
modernlife.book.page8:
Phone 2:

Iron Ingot, Glass Pane, Redstone and Red Dye, any slots.
modernlife.book.page9:
Presidential Ballot:

Compass, Gold Ingot and Paper, any slots.
modernlife.book.page10:
Admin Ballot:

a Presidential Ballot and a Diamond, any slots.

Turn the page to continue!
modernlife.book.page11:
Now that we learned the items, let's see how to start:

1. Craft an ID card and register it to your name.
2. Open an account at an ATM and get a card.
3. Trade with NPCs.
4. Craft a phone.
5. Run your shop with the cash register!
modernlife.book.page12:
Tradeable Items:
All ores, stone types, woods, and basic resources.

You can earn money by trading these items. (NPCs only buy items to keep economy balanced).
modernlife.book.page13:
Elections:
Craft a ballot for each player. Craft 1 Admin Ballot to start/stop elections and elect your president.

The president manages taxes and fines.
modernlife.book.page14:
Fines:
Current fine: Driving Without a License.

If you haven't crafted and registered a license, you get fined. Default fine is 100 TL.
modernlife.book.page15:
Commands:
President / OP:
- /modernlife balance: Adjust balances.
- /modernlife president: Set president.
- /modernlife world: Tax info.

Public:
- /modernlife donate_treasury: Donate to treasury.
modernlife.book.page16:
Devices:
- ATM: Withdraw/deposit cash, manage cards.
- Cash Register: Link bank account & set prices.
- Phone: Maps, EFT transfers, e-Government & voice chat!
